name: What are the most common upgrades for tiny homes?
description: Common tiny home upgrades include solar power, composting toilets, high-efficiency appliances, and custom built-in furniture to maximize space and efficiency.

mainEntity.name: What are the most common upgrades for tiny homes?

acceptedAnswer.text: Popular tiny home upgrades often focus on maximizing comfort, efficiency, and functionality within a compact space. Common additions include solar power systems for energy independence, composting toilets or waterless incinerating toilets for off-grid living, and high-efficiency appliances like induction cooktops or tankless water heaters. Many clients also opt for custom built-in furniture, such as murphy beds or convertible dining areas, to enhance space utilization. Smart home technology for climate control or lighting can also be integrated for added convenience.
acceptedAnswer.description: Common tiny home upgrades include solar power, composting toilets, high-efficiency appliances, and custom built-in furniture to maximize space and efficiency.
